texts.en: Our energy deficit is out of control! [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] demands that we take drastic action to take hold of the situation, failing which severe cutbacks will be necessary in a matter of months.

texts.zh: 我们的能量币赤字已经失控！我们的资源分配子个体面对我们补给线健康度的读数时愈发地焦虑不安了。它们预计，如果无法采取有效行动，在数月之后必须要大幅削减开支。
texts.en: Our energy deficit is out of control! Our resource distribution drones are increasingly agitated at the readings they measure on the health of our supply lines. They forecast that drastic cutbacks will be necessary in a matter of months unless significant action is taken.

Everything is going according to plan.

texts.zh: 我们没能避免破产。经历了数月的能量币短缺之后，我们别无选择，只能拖欠债务并大幅削减开支。
texts.en: We have failed to stave off bankruptcy. Following months of energy shortages that have become terminal, we have had no choice but to default on our debts and make sharp cutbacks to our expenditures.

texts.zh: 我们没能平衡收支。经历了数月的能量币短缺之后，我们别无选择，只能对我们的资源分发系统强制执行大规模重组。
texts.en: We have failed to rebalance our expenditures. Following months of energy shortages that have become terminal, we have had no choice but to enforce large-scale reallocations to our resource distribution systems.

texts.en: According to our espionage reports, [kaleidoscope_new_owner.GetName], is currently suffering from an energy shortage. The Kaleidoscope we gifted them seems to be the main cause of their economic troubles.

summary.text:
# 能量短缺 / Energy Shortages
- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 资源赤字情境 resource-deficit situation

## 如何开始 How it starts

资源赤字情境是引擎在该资源出现实际赤字时开始的（脚本中没有 start_situation 调用，仅在 `first_contact_dlc_effects.txt:2960–3020` 等处按类型引用）；初始进度 15，共四个阶段（进度 25 / 50 / 75 / 100），每个阶段的惩罚递增：民用经济外交权重 −10%…−50%、人口组装减慢、舰船伤害与航速 −20%…−80%（非生物舰船）、机械帝国的科研劳动力 −33%…−75%（`02_deficit_situations.txt:1–16, 16–300`）。每月进度：赤字时增加“赤字进度值”，收入不为负时 −5，有库存缓冲时 −1；平民难度 ×0.1、学员难度 ×0.5（对非AI）。进度满即“破产”；情境被中止时按资源给予救助金。 / The engine starts a resource-deficit situation when the country has an actual deficit of that resource (no start_situation call exists in the shipped scripts; only type switches in first_contact_dlc_effects.txt:2960–3020). It begins at progress 15 with four stages (25 / 50 / 75 / 100) whose penalties escalate: diplomatic economy weight −10%…−50%, slower pop assembly, ship damage and speed −20%…−80% (non-bio ships), machine research workforce −33%…−75%. Monthly progress rises with the deficit, falls by 5 when income is not negative and by 1 with a stockpile; civilian difficulty ×0.1, cadet ×0.5 for humans. Full progress is bankruptcy; aborting grants a bailout.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. **情境“能源短缺”**：路线（approach）：无作为（默认）/ 削减科研投入（研究员产出 −50%，建筑能量维护 −20%）。/ Approaches: do nothing (default) / cut science investment (researcher output −50%, building energy upkeep −20%).
2. **进入第四阶段（进度 ≥75）→ deficit.100 失控的赤字**：A 向支持者借款（仅当统治者有所属派系）/ B 从被掠夺的星球上重新分配资源（需有被掠夺星球）/ C 一切按计划进行。 / A borrow from supporters (needs a ruler faction), B reallocate resources from a looted planet, C everything goes to plan.
3. **进度满 → deficit.110 破产！**：违约并大幅削减开支（意识集合则强制重新分配资源）。/ Progress complete → bankruptcy event deficit.110: the country defaults and makes sharp cutbacks. 开始时（`on_start`）还会：向本国发出顾问事件 advisor.20（10–30 天后）与时间线事件 timeline.19；若曾把“万花筒”交给他国，则在 10–30 天后向那个国家发 **situation.2025「甩掉包袱」**；情境月度有 20% 概率触发 origin.4170（“偿还”起源中的 MSI 援助）。 On start it also fires advisor.20 (10–30 days) and timeline.19, sends situation.2025 “Offloading The Problem” to the country that received the Kaleidoscope, and monthly 20% for origin.4170 (Payback’s MSI help).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

没有分叉结局：要么在进度满前把赤字扭转（情境失败 = 解除），要么破产。/ No branching ending: either the deficit is reversed before completion (the situation fails and ends) or bankruptcy follows.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

意识集合/机械帝国有不同文本与惩罚；破碎枷锁/分离主义者的相关支援会在阶段2–4提供少量资源。/ Gestalt and machine empires have different texts and penalties; separatist help (Fear of the Dark) adds small resources in stages 2–4.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：情境定义、阶段惩罚、进度公式、路线，以及阶段四和破产事件。/ Situation definition, stage penalties, progress formula, approaches and the stage-4 and bankruptcy events.
- 审阅改动 Changes：编译结构正确（情境 → 阶段四事件 → 破产事件）；补充了共同机制与本资源的路线。/ The compiled structure was correct; the shared mechanism and this resource’s approaches are documented.
